title: Review findings
description: Strict output contract for the reviewer (Layer 2). Free-form prose is not accepted.

id.description: Stable id within this run, e.g. F-001. Must be unique across the findings array — number them in sequence. A repeated id fails the whole run, not just the duplicate.

file.description: Repository-relative path, exactly as it appears in the diff

code_quote.description: Verbatim source at that line. Verified against the file; a quote found elsewhere is relocated, a quote found nowhere is dropped.

severity.description: Derived from the violated rule's level: MUST=blocker, SHOULD=major, MAY=minor

rule_violated.description: Pointer to the rule: REVIEW_POLICY.md R-011, CLEAN_CODE.md#naming, lint rule id

evidence.description: For bug/security/perf: concrete input to wrong output, or a failing test. For style/arch: the quoted rule. Never a restatement of the code.

reproducible.description: True only if evidence is a concrete counterexample or a failing test

confidence.description: confirmed = proven by execution or an exact rule match; possible = pattern match only

suggested_fix.description: Optional, one sentence. The reviewer does not write patches.
